change_summary: Real game Stage1 texture combiner b1 uses one device-owned native D3D11 constant buffer, refreshes the captured game operands/factors for every Draw/DrawIndexed, explicitly unbinds for stage0-only menu/HUD draws, and releases on rebuild/Reset, preserving original D3D9 game/input fallback.

feature_contract.goal: Menu, vehicle selection, and race Stage-1 D3D9 combiner source states survive the real native Draw/DrawIndexed chain through GPU b1 ownership and full-frame presentation without per-draw immutable D3D11 allocations, cross-draw stale constants, or interruption of gamepad/D3D9 fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Each supported game-author Stage1 captures factors, TEMP routing, stage constants and texture mode, uploads b1 in game draw order, and binds it on the corresponding real full-frame native Draw/DrawIndexed.
Game-authored stage0-only draws clear D3D11 b1, device Reset/resize retires old GPU object, and buffer setup/unknown states cannot bypass the original D3D9 Draw or gamepad input.
Destructive Stage1 upload/lifetime/PS unbind regressions fail locally, exact-SHA five mandatory GitHub Actions succeed, and runtime HMD success remains unclaimed.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Draw/DrawIndexed submitted for game menu, vehicle and race can use the same native b1 allocation while reflecting different original game stage1 constants per draw, even across stage0-only draws; HMD pixels not asserted.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Native gameplay opt-in remains default-off, Stage1 resource setup fails closed before native submission, D3D9 source Draw/Present and controller inputs remain authoritative.
integration_path: R30 real game Stage1 state capture -> native 80-byte GPU constant-buffer UpdateSubresource
Per-draw PS b1 bind or stage0 unbind -> native Draw/DrawIndexed -> guarded full-resolution readback/Present with DX9Ex fallback
batch_components: D3D11 production renderer GPU constant buffer ownership, game-authored stage1 payload mapping, PS binding and Reset lifetime
Destructive Python source regression executed in exact-SHA Fast workflow plus existing Windows source compile and fallback guard

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Native Stage1 b1 lifetime is device-owned, initialized with 80 aligned bytes, updated from real game factors, constants and texture operand routing on every Stage1 Draw, then bound before native GPU Draw.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Mutations removing device reset, GPU update, shader b1 unbind, buffer size or ready-check are rejected; original D3D9 gamepad/render remains authoritative.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: D3D9 captured game Stage1 state -> D3D11 PS constant-buffer UpdateSubresource/PSSetConstantBuffers -> native IA/DrawIndexed -> same-Present full-frame diagnostic output.
